scope: Evidence-only independent review of the exact-source T30 revalidation packet. Product source, task state, root configuration, budgets and lockfiles were not modified; the author timing/package commands were not rerun.

evidence.detail: Inventory for the two review records; manifest and inventory are excluded to avoid a circular hash.

decision.review: The author packet is internally consistent and supports bounded T30 approval with three explicit P2 follow-ups.

limits: No full timing/browser/install rerun was performed by the independent reviewer.
The consumer lock references ephemeral author tarball paths; exact tarball bytes are not retained for independent replay.
Manual assistive-technology certification, lower-powered-device and cross-browser timing, field metrics, model/provider quality, publication and deployment are not claimed.
